scripts.dev: bun run --filter '@brightloop/shared' build && concurrently -k -n shared,core,web "bun run --filter @brightloop/shared dev" "bun run --filter @odoo/core dev" "bun run --filter @odoo/web dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter '@brightloop/shared' build && bun run --filter '*' build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@brightloop/shared' build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@brightloop/shared' test && bun run --filter '@odoo/core' test
